title: Blueberry Granola Bars
excerpt: Make delicious blueberry granola bars at home, perfect to take anywhere and enjoy a snack full of flavor and texture.
imageAlt: Homemade blueberry granola bars cut into rectangular portions on a wooden board.
steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and line a square pan with wax paper.
In a large bowl, mix the traditional oats, the chopped almonds and the pinch of salt.
Add the honey and the melted coconut oil to the dry mix, combining very well with a spatula until everything is moist.
Gently fold in the Fresh Pick blueberries, which, with their high-mountain origin grown in Guasca, add an unmatched sweet and juicy touch.
Transfer the mixture to the prepared pan and press it firmly with the back of a spoon so it forms a compact layer.
Bake for 25 minutes or until the edges start to turn lightly golden.
Remove from the oven and let cool completely at room temperature, then refrigerate for 60 minutes before cutting into rectangular portions.
tips: To keep the bars crunchy, store them in an airtight container in the fridge, separated by layers of wax paper.
If you have blueberries left over, keep them in their original packaging in the refrigerator, unwashed, until you are ready to use them so they keep their natural bloom and freshness.
